_comment: Octail test-game egg: a tiny shell 'game' for CI, the Linode dev node and /selftest (plan §12, §9.15).
name: Octail Test Game
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: Prints a start-detection line, echoes console input and exits cleanly on "stop". Uses almost no memory. The install script writes start.sh, because the yolk entrypoint runs the startup line without a shell.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -e
cd /mnt/server
echo "installed at $(date -u +%FT%TZ)" > installed.txt
touch server.properties
cat > start.sh <<'EOS'
#!/bin/sh
# Octail test game: prints the start line, echoes console input, exits cleanly on "stop".
echo "[test-game] Server started on port ${SERVER_PORT} (motd: ${MOTD})"
while read -r line; do
  echo "[test-game] echo: $line"
  if [ "$line" = "stop" ]; then echo "[test-game] stopping"; exit 0; fi
done
EOS
chmod +x start.sh
echo "[test-game] install finished"

variables.name: Message of the day
variables.description: Shown in the start line and written to server.properties.
